name: G.G Series Collection +
summary:
A compilation cartridge for DS featuring 30 G.G Series games: All 16 G.G Series titles available on DSiWare as of March 2010 in Japan, plus 14 original titles that were later released on DSiWare in July 2015--the final titles to be released for the service before it was shut down in 2017.

A near-full collection, only missing 4 G.G Series titles: Z.ONE 2, Super Hero Ogre 2, Ninja Karakuri Den 2, and Drift Circuit 2. Complete objectives in G.G Series games to gain points. Spend points to unlock more G.G Series games, as well as customization options for the navigator character on the top screen.
